_description: Single source of truth for the CoinCync testnet fleet topology. Every node in `nodes` has every other node added to its --addnode dial list via scripts/render-systemd-unit.sh + scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh. When a node is added, removed, or has its IP changed: (1) edit this file, (2) keep TESTNET_SEED_NODES (src/testnet.rs) and TESTNET_FALLBACK (src/network/dns_seeds.rs) in sync with the seed/relay-role entries here, (3) run scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh, (4) verify every node converges. See docs/operations/fleet-config.md for the runbook.
_last_changed: 2026-09-06 — consolidated to Hetzner. The entire Vultr fleet (seed1/2/3, explorer, api, miners, relays) was decommissioned (unreachable since 2026-07-27) and is moved to `deactivated`. The single live public seed is the Hetzner box 2.28.1.75:28080, matching TESTNET_SEED_NODES / TESTNET_FALLBACK. The residential home node stays DNS-only (privacy) and is intentionally not listed here. Append additional Hetzner boxes as the fleet is re-provisioned.
_rpc_bind_policy: Per-host RPC bind address. 127.0.0.1 means loopback-only (RPC only reachable from localhost; safer default; assumes nginx or stunnel for any public exposure). 0.0.0.0 means listen on all interfaces (public RPC). Keep loopback unless the host is intentionally serving public RPC behind nginx.

seed1.notes: Hetzner (EU) — stable public testnet seed. Sole live public bootstrap node as of 2026-09-06. RPC loopback-only (seed role doesn't need exposed RPC; front with nginx and set rpc_bind 0.0.0.0 only if this box intentionally serves public RPC). Must stay in sync with TESTNET_SEED_NODES (src/testnet.rs) and TESTNET_FALLBACK (src/network/dns_seeds.rs).

deactivated._description: Nodes that were once in the fleet but no longer participate. Kept for historical reference; NOT added to addnode lists. Re-activate by moving back into `nodes`, syncing the code seed lists, and re-running sync-fleet-config.sh.
